The runtime guard admits or refuses concrete uses by card, actual user and target. It never adds native effect scores to planner utility. A credible negative actor component with deterioration of at least 2 native evaluation units activates immediate planning for the request. Both ordinary and core continuations are bypassed. Separate severe skill penalties survive unrelated positive bonuses. Native actor-zero tokens neutralize final actor evaluation. These units are heuristic AI evaluation units, not HP.

Fresh callback outputs and seed values enter the cache signature. Equivalent card/user/target probes share results within one request. Current held Sha uses are also checked before range or mark preparation can enable them. Borrowed sword probes the secondary Sha user, and Qinglong probes known followups or a synthetic Sha. These checks use current public and owner-known state. They cannot predict a penalty that only appears after a future state change.

The adapter reads owner hand identities and other players' known or shown cards. Arbitrary native seed/effect JavaScript can query hidden state itself or perform side effects. It is not sandboxed. Event property descriptors and selection array identities/content are restored. Other callback mutations are outside this guarantee. Thrown, malformed, null and unsupported callback returns produce unknown diagnostics without inventing a penalty. External positive effects are not optimized. No multiplayer or performance claim is made.

`luofei_effect_characters.js` defines a pure blank and two pseudo blanks. Their only skills contain `ai.effect`, with no trigger, content or mod. The effect test uses the existing real-engine VM harness. It supplies a constant Sha target seed because that harness lacks helpers used by stock Sha's target AI. The protocol oracle runs the real `get.effect_use` method with those same controlled seeds. Native card, user and target selection are exercised separately.

`jie_luofei_blank_differential_test.js` reads a stored golden generated from the SHA-verified original. Ten stock blank scenarios compare twelve complete snapshots, decisions and native choices. The three-decision wine trace advances controlled public resources between real native choice queries. It is a controlled state-transition trace, not a full battle. It also records two dangerous original pseudo-blank decisions and verifies the candidate refuses them. No candidate output is used as the original expectation.

Run `node tests/jie_luofei_effect_risk_test.js` and `node tests/jie_luofei_blank_differential_test.js`. Pass `--baseline <original AI file>` to rerun the original and verify the golden. Add `--write-golden` only to regenerate the original golden after SHA verification. The baseline SHA is `12a90c940db21d7dbd87296fa3c754f60b32c2ced8f6a3d474e00a6ecb96d1dc`.
